workload.command: python -I -c "import random, string, timeit, tiktoken; enc = tiktoken.get_encoding('r50k_base'); words = enc.decode(list(range(1000, 6000))).split(); rng = random.Random(0); text = ' '.join(rng.choice(words) if rng.random() < 0.5 else ''.join(rng.choices(string.ascii_lowercase, k=rng.randint(4, 14))) for _ in range(200000)); print(min(timeit.repeat(lambda: enc.encode(text), number=1, repeat=3)))"
workload.source: written here from the description of https://github.com/openai/tiktoken/pull/31 (byte pair encoding speed): encode 200000 words, half drawn from the r50k_base vocabulary and half random letter strings

oracle.source: tiktoken's own tests; the vocabulary is downloaded by the tests

evidence.note: description, as matched by the miner: speedup claims: 2x | timings: 24 ms
